summary_en: 5,000,000 shares (2.81% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) | ¥10.0 billion upper limit | open-market acquisition on TSE | Aug 3, 2026 – Aug 2, 2027 | acquired shares to be cancelled | rationale: capital efficiency and expanded shareholder returns
title_en: Notice regarding determination of matters relating to acquisition of own shares
translation_en_brief: Kansai Paint announced on 26 June 2026 that its board has authorized the acquisition of its own shares under Article 156 of the Companies Act (as applied via Article 165(3)). The program authorizes the purchase of up to 5,000,000 ordinary shares (2.81% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) at a maximum aggregate cost of ¥10.0 billion. Acquisition will occur via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 3 August 2026 and 2 August 2027. Execution is subject to market conditions; the company notes that orders may not be fully executed. Acquired shares are intended for cancellation. The stated rationale is to enhance capital efficiency and expand shareholder returns.
